dialogue.raw: §fOw! That's my face you're stepping on!
dialogue.text: Ow! That's my face you're stepping on!
dialogue.zh: 嗷! 你踩着我的脸了!

dialogue.context: Plate / First Step (Before starting the race)
dialogue.raw: §fShow some respect and punch the "§6§lREADY§f" hologram, please.
dialogue.text: Show some respect and punch the "READY" hologram, please.
dialogue.zh: 尊重我一下，麻烦去打那个写着"准备就绪"的浮空字。

dialogue.context: Plate / Future Step-Ons (Before starting the race)
dialogue.raw: §fAh, the sweet sensation of being stepped on again. If only there was a way to avoid this!
dialogue.text: Ah, the sweet sensation of being stepped on again. If only there was a way to avoid this!
dialogue.zh: 啊，又是被踩的美妙滋味。要是能躲开就好了!

dialogue.raw: §fOuch! Did you miss the §6§lREADY§f sign or do you just enjoy causing pain?
dialogue.text: Ouch! Did you miss the READY sign or do you just enjoy causing pain?
dialogue.zh: 哎哟! 你是没看见准备就绪的牌子，还是就喜欢折磨人?

segments.text: sign or do you just enjoy causing pain?

dialogue.raw: §fEver considered punching something? Say, a hologram?
dialogue.text: Ever considered punching something? Say, a hologram?
dialogue.zh: 有没有考虑过打点别的? 比如，浮空字?

dialogue.text: Marvelous, another footprint for my collection!
dialogue.zh: 妙啊，我的脚印收藏又多了一个!

dialogue.raw: §fBack for more, I see. If only there was a big, glowing hint above me on what to do instead...
dialogue.text: Back for more, I see. If only there was a big, glowing hint above me on what to do instead...
dialogue.zh: 看来你还没踩够。要是我头顶能有个又大又亮的提示，告诉你该干什么就好了……

dialogue.raw: §fYou treat all inanimate objects this way, or am I just the lucky one? Try the §6§lREADY§f hologram for a change.
